bundle.shortDescription: Professional audio playback and A/B comparison
bundle.longDescription: Onyx is a fast, accurate audio player for critical listening: bit-transparent playback that follows the source sample rate, two decks sharing one playhead for instant A/B comparison, LUFS-based level matching, blind testing and standards-compliant BS.1770-4 / EBU R128 metering.
